verdict.rationale: First-party docs list tool calling and reasoning parsers as a feature (vllm-docs-8). They detail tool_choice support in the chat completion API: named, auto, required and none (vllm-docs-19). They also document that reasoning models return a separate `reasoning` field (vllm-docs-21). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-calling or reasoning-parser behavior, and no detail on which models or parsers are covered.
